_note: 行内命令目录。AI 只能从这里【挑】—— 发明不出新命令, 也指定不了去处(语法里根本没有『地址』这个字段)。目录里没有的名字会在屏幕上红字显示, 不会被静默吞掉。写法: {{cmd:name|k=v|label=按钮文字}}
_channel_note: channel 是去处。个人版只有 local —— 什么都不出这台机器。行业版才有 business/admin 那两条通往平台的路, 别照抄过来: 个人版压根没有『我们的服务端』这一侧。
_notify_note: notify_ai=false 的命令执行完不通知 AI(默认 true)。18 步的手顺每按一次『下一步』都叫一次 AI, 就是 18 次计费 —— 只是翻屏的操作必须在本机了结。真让外面世界动起来的操作才该是 true。

wf_go.summary: Advance the workflow one screen. Tapping it switches to the next screen immediately — does not call AI, so it costs nothing no matter how many times you tap, and tapping the same spot always produces the same screen.

to.note: id of the step to navigate to. Omit it on an entry button: the engine lands on the first step not yet done. Do not look the progress up and pass it back — the engine already holds it.

from.note: id of the step currently displayed (only needed when printing)

mark.note: mark to stamp on `from`: done or skipped. **Do not stamp when navigating backwards** — glancing back should not rewrite the record.

wf_finish.summary: Final screen of the workflow. The personal edition has no platform to report to, so this is the end — stamp the mark first, same as the business edition.

from.note: id of the final step (stamps it as done)
